text:
QUOTE: "the index scope is decided by a `.clew.yaml` `index_scope:` section if one is declared and usable. If not, the scope is the whole repository"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the declared index_scope is preferred and that when it is not usable the scope falls back to the whole repository. It also covers the present-but-rejected case, which it handles with a warning and the whole-repo fallback (though it says a broken declaration is refused at the CLI level).
